title: 第2章【冥婚】剧本
slug: 诡异副本勇敢者的游戏
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“我叫顾原......”

看到这几个字的时候顾原明显愣住了，这剧本中的角色竟然和自己的名字一样，这是巧合，还是？

隐约中，顾原已经感觉到有些不对劲了。

“世代住在杏花村，我是我家的老大，还有个老二，叫顾方，我们兄弟两个关系很好，但是家里很穷，我们两个之间只能有一个可以娶媳妇，我身为老大，很疼爱弟弟，自然是将这个好事让给了弟弟，但是我也有私心。”

“在同村中，我有一个青梅竹马，她叫方清......”

看到这里的时候，顾原抬起了头环顾了一圈，如果按照自己刚才所想的话，那么这剩下几个人中肯定还有一个叫做方清的。

但是现场除了自己以外的八个人，只有三个女的，其中一个是中年妇女，顾原希望方清不是她，即使是假的，顾原也不希望自己二十多岁的大好青年的青梅竹马是个看上去四十多岁的中年妇女。

除此之外，还有两个女的，一个长相比较乖巧，另一个则比较文静，这两个谁成为他的新娘，顾原心里都是可以接受的。

“可是，事情并没有像我想的那样简单，一切都朝着不可控的方向发展过去。”

“我的青梅竹马方清，她被迫嫁入了村里的恶霸马天，而且此时的马天已经快要死了，她是被拉去冲喜的，然而冲喜并没有成功，马天还是死了，但更恐怖的事情出现了，村子里竟然开始死人，有人说是因为马天不甘心死去化作怨鬼，所以他要报复村子里的人，而村子里的人为了平息众怒，他们杀死了方清，让其与死去的马天配冥婚。”

“我不甘心，想要带着方清一起离开，可是方清已经死了。”

“不对......她没有死！”

就在顾原准备看下去的时候，西装男的声音出现了。

“各位，三分钟时间已到，接下来请各位玩家前往指定场景。”

话音落下，原本安静的房间中忽地传出了一阵风声，紧接着那根并不怎么亮的蜡烛像是被人吹灭了一样暗了下去，周围的环境开始莫名变的阴冷，很快就陷入了伸手不见五指的黑暗中。

等到周围视线恢复一点，顾原才看到自己已经在一座荒败的村子里，村子的房子像是上个世纪的，基本上全是土房，而且很多地方已经开裂甚至坍塌。

周围只有顾原一个人，他身后的房间莫名的有些熟悉，这应该是剧本杀中顾原的家才对。

看来每个玩家都会被传送到自己的家里。

作为一个资深的剧本杀玩家，即使这个剧本杀很诡异危险，但是万变不离其宗，总体玩法是一样的。

但是自己对剧本并没有看完，只看了十分之一的剧情，后面的内容需要自己猜才对。

所以，在这之前，顾原需要先去寻找方清。

但是方清家的路顾原并不知道怎么走。

但有了这个念头后，顾原的脑子里竟然凭空出现了一条熟悉的路，像是自己曾经走过成千上万次一样。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"My name is Gu Yuan..."

When he saw these words, Gu Yuan was obviously stunned. The character in the script had the same name as his own. Was this a coincidence, or was it?

Vaguely, Gu Yuan already felt that something was wrong.

"I have lived in Xinghua Village for generations. I am the eldest brother in my family, and I have a second child named Gu Fang. We two brothers have a good relationship, but our family is very poor. Only one of us can marry a wife. As the eldest brother, I love my younger brother very much, so naturally I give this good thing to my younger brother, but I also have selfish motives."

"In the same village, I have a childhood sweetheart, her name is Fang Qing..."

When he saw this, Gu Yuan raised his head and looked around. If he went by what he had just thought, then there must be one named Fang Qing among the few remaining people.

But among the eight people present except himself, there were only three women, one of whom was a middle-aged woman. Gu Yuan hoped that Fang Qing was not her. Even if it was fake, Gu Yuan did not want his childhood sweetheart, a good young man in his twenties, to be a middle-aged woman who looked to be in her forties.

In addition, there are two women, one is more well-behaved and the other is more quiet. Gu Yuan can accept whoever becomes his bride.

"However, things were not as simple as I thought. Everything developed in an uncontrollable direction."

"My childhood sweetheart Fang Qing, she was forced to marry Ma Tian, a bully in the village, and Ma Tian was about to die at this time. She was dragged to the wedding, but the wedding did not succeed. Ma Tian still died, but something more terrifying happened., people started to die in the village. Some people said that it was because Ma Tian was unwilling to die and turned into a resentful ghost, so he wanted to take revenge on the people in the village. In order to calm down the public anger, the people in the village killed Fang Qing and let him marry the dead Ma Tian."

"I was unwilling to give in and wanted to leave with Fang Qing, but Fang Qing was already dead."

"No...she's not dead!"

Just when Gu Yuan was about to read on, the voice of the man in a suit appeared.

"Everyone, three minutes have expired. Next, all players are invited to go to the designated scene."

As soon as the words fell, a gust of wind suddenly came from the originally quiet room, and then the candle that was not very bright dimmed as if it had been blown out. The surrounding environment began to become inexplicably cold, and soon fell into the darkness where one couldn't even see his fingers.

When his surroundings recovered a little, Gu Yuan saw that he was already in a deserted village. The houses in the village seemed to be from the last century. They were basically all mud houses, and many places had cracked or even collapsed.

There was only Gu Yuan around, and the room behind him seemed inexplicably familiar. This should be Gu Yuan's home in the script.

It appears that each player will be teleported to their home.

As a senior script killing player, even though this script killing is very strange and dangerous, it remains the same and the overall gameplay is the same.

But I haven't read the entire script, I've only read one-tenth of the plot, and I need to guess the rest of it myself.

Therefore, before that, Gu Yuan needs to find Fang Qing first.

But Gu Yuan didn't know how to go to Fang Qing's house.

But after having this idea, a familiar road suddenly appeared in Gu Yuan's mind, as if he had walked it thousands of times before.
